reason: It's free and I can sign up in two minutes, and the coupon-and-PIN count finally gives me cost per customer per creator, which I've never had from Instagram collabs. I'll list one offer and see whether the redemptions show up in my evening numbers.
objection: Will good creators actually be on it, or just people with bought followers chasing a free coffee? It's also a beta with a small team, so I worry the coupons won't get redeemed properly at a busy counter and the ₹200 a month will quietly stop.
would_change_my_mind: If after a month the creators who show interest are weak or nobody comes in with a coupon, I'll stop using it. Seeing two or three real creators near me with decent average views before I list would make me commit properly.
